# Shiksha Design

> Shiksha Design is an industry-leading education and skill training platform offering certified courses in UI/UX Design, Web Development, Graphic Design, and AI tools.

## Main Pages

- [Home Page](https://shikshadesign.com/): Official Homepage of Shiksha Design
- [Courses](https://shikshadesign.com/courses): Browse all certified skill development courses
- [About Us](https://shikshadesign.com/about-us): Learn about Shiksha Design, our mission, and faculty
- [Contact Us](https://shikshadesign.com/contact-us): Get in touch for course admissions and inquiries
- [Blog](https://shikshadesign.com/blog): Articles and insights on design, tech, and career growth
- [Privacy Policy](https://shikshadesign.com/privacy-policy): Shiksha Design privacy policy guidelines
- [Disclaimer](https://shikshadesign.com/disclaimer): Website disclaimer and liability terms
- [Terms & Conditions Enrolment](https://shikshadesign.com/terms-and-conditions-enrolment): Official enrolment rules and student terms
